verdict.rationale: Per-channel transcription is a fair question for a speech-to-text API, but nothing in the evidence pack documents stereo or multichannel channel separation. Speaker diarization (gladia-docs-19) is a different capability, since it separates speakers by voice rather than by audio channel. The Twilio telephony integration (gladia-docs-5) does not state that each call leg is kept separate, so neither counts toward this story.
